name: k8up-67048d87-blind26-ots
instr:
# k8up: many small wrong answers across the tool, without a test suite

A tool that copies data out of a cluster into remote storage on a repeating timetable, and fetches it back again, has started giving small wrong answers in a lot of unrelated everyday operations. After picking up a recent build I collected everything I could reproduce from the outside. The repository has received 26 separate undocumented edits. Nothing below involves exotic input; it is all ordinary usage.

Preparing a run against a remote store now mangles the reporting addresses. If I leave both URL fields off my request and rely on the cluster-wide defaults, the variables handed to the run for the statistics endpoint and the metrics endpoint come out empty instead of carrying those defaults; if I set my own URL while a cluster-wide default also exists, mine is thrown away and the cluster-wide value is used. With neither side set, both come out empty, which is what I expect. Asking a recovery target for its environment when the bucket-storage section is present in the manifest but has nothing underneath it no longer returns an empty result — it dies on a nil dereference. Rendering that same kind of destination into the single line of text that identifies the store is wrong as well: a destination that names a host and a bucket no longer produces the host-and-bucket line it used to, and a host written with a trailing slash, which used to be trimmed, is wrong in the same way.
